learning_units.description: Three-step vandana salutation sequence (head, face, chest).
Foundational chouka square stance and tribhangi three-bend posture.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestural mudras used for expressive storytelling (abhinaya); three-step salutation hands raised above head, at face, and at chest.
movement_profile.footwork: Rhythmic feet tapping accented by ankle bells; basic stances involve grounded wide square stepping (chouka) and three-bend stance (tribhangi).
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group formations transitioning into intricate sculptural human arrangements for acrobatic bandha figures.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Fluid movement in the upper torso; sharp side bends and waist bends forming tribhangi.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Extensive ground-level, kneeling, seated, and inverted yogic acrobatic figures (bandha).
movement_profile.partnering: Group acrobatics forming composite shapes (such as Kandarpa Ratha chariot or Sagadi wheel).
movement_profile.posture: Postures include tribhangi (body held with three bends at head, torso, and knees) and chouka (a wide square-like stance). Upper torso is highly fluid, moving like gentle sea waves.

signature_moves.description: A square-like wide standing stance symbolizing Lord Jagannath.
signature_moves.name: Chouka

signature_moves.description: A three-bend posture with flexions at the head, torso, and knees.
signature_moves.name: Tribhangi

signature_moves.description: Intricate acrobatic yogic poses inspired by mythological themes.
signature_moves.name: Bandha Nrutya

signature_moves.description: Peacock bandha pose symbolizing Krishna's feather.
signature_moves.name: Mayura

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Fluid and expressive during abhinaya; sharp and dynamic during bandha acrobatic transitions.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid forceful bending without years of early suppleness training; handle sacred attire, jewelry, and ankle bells with reverence.

music_profile.musical_form: Odissi music structure transitioning from devotional invocation (vandana) to technical rhythmic passages (sarigama) and expressional narrative poetry (abhinaya).
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Rhythmic patterns tapped out by footwork and accented by mardala beats, ankle bells, and gini cymbals.
music_profile.sound_description: A traditional Odissi musical ensemble led by the resonant two-headed mardala drum and metallic gini cymbals, layered with harmonium, violin, and bansuri flute, supporting vocal recitations sung by the young dancers.
music_profile.vocal_style: Singing performed directly by the dancers along with one or two dedicated vocalists, reciting ornate Odia poetry and Gita Govinda verses.

basic_steps: Vandana three-step salutation (hands above head to God, at face for guru, at chest for audience)
Chouka stance (square-like posture symbolizing Lord Jagannath)
Tribhangi posture (three-bend posture at head, torso, and knees)
Torso wave movement (fluid upper torso motion resembling sea waves)
Bandha Nrutya acrobatic formation (entering yogic poses such as Padmasana or Mayura)
teaching.formation: Group of young male dancers performing in synchronized lines, small clusters, or forming multi-person yogic figures.
teaching.level_notes: Requires intense physical flexibility, suppleness of limb, and early childhood training (starting age 5 or 6).
teaching.rhythm: Odissi rhythmic cycles played on the mardala drum and accented by ankle bells and gini cymbals.
